allow_http.description: The server's current providers.allow_http_upstreams permission for this address call; absent, false.

provider.description: The provider's current name for the source's call context; absent on older commands.

name.description: The built-in source or the program, by name.

address.description: The address, with how it is authorized and whether the provider's key may be sent to it.

config.description: What the provider's managers gave for the source's fields that are no secrets.

secrets.description: The values of the source's secret fields, by field.

authorization.description: The address's authorization: the bearer token, or the value of the named header.

description:
What the server tells the machine that keeps the credential of the source of one element, for one call.
Where a command carries none, the default source is used, as before sources could be chosen.
title: SourceSpec

SourceAskProvider.description: The provider a call is about.

oneOf.description:
What follows from the provider's credential and endpoints ([`default_source`]): its harness for a
sign-in, a vendor's reads of a key at its hosts, each endpoint's list of models, else nothing.
A program registered on the machine that keeps the credential, by `name`.
An address, reached from the machine that keeps the credential.

Nothing: no facts are read beside what the keeper reports, no models are listed (they are added by
name), no key is presented but by its own rule.

url.description: The address requests are posted to.

auth.description: How requests to it are authorized.

send_credential.description:
Whether the provider's key is sent to it, as `params.credential.key`: only where its managers turned
that on for this address, and only for a key.

SourceAddress.description:
An address a source is reached at, with how it is authorized and whether the provider's key may be sent
to it. The authorization itself is a provider secret, never part of it.

oneOf.description: The token as the value of the header named in `header`.

AddressAuth.description: How a request to an address is authorized: as an endpoint's key is presented.

oneOf.description: As the command is kept: the identifier of the secret.
As the command is sent: the value, sealed to the machine it goes to.

SourceSecret.description:
A secret of a source on its way to the machine that keeps the credential: as the server keeps the
command, the identifier of the provider secret; as the command is sent, its value sealed to that machine.
It is written as the link writes every secret of a command (`{"$secret": id}`, `{"$sealed": "…"}`).
